subject: Next steps: IAM evidence & SOC 2 status (FinPay)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@finpay.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-10T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps: IAM evidence & SOC 2 status (FinPay)

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for taking the time today — really helpful to understand FinPay's risk model and the integrations you're planning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep the security review moving: 

Recap from today's call:
- FinPay evaluates vendors on SOC 2 Type II, SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, and RBAC controls.
- You're planning a pilot integration for Q3 with a small set of test users.
- Your security team will own the vendor security questionnaire and technical SSO testing.

Redwood items requested (IAM & evidence):
1) SSO/SAML: Redwood SAML metadata (EntityID, ACS URL), recommended IdP mapping, and test SP metadata.
2) SCIM provisioning: high-level SCIM flow, supported attributes, and provisioning throttling/SCIM de-provisioning behavior.
3) RBAC/admin controls: roles matrix (which roles have which privileges), console admin controls, and separation-of-duty notes.
4) Audit & logging: retention period for auth/audit logs and examples of event types (login, token revoke, role changes).
5) Offboarding: process for user deprovisioning and any automated workflows tied to SCIM or SSO.
6) SOC 2 status: current state (in-scope systems, auditor, expected Type II report date).

I've attached a blank vendor questionnaire (vendor-questionnaire.xlsx) to make it easy for your team to fill. Suggested next steps: 
- Samantha: please confirm who on your security side will own the questionnaire (and cc them).
- FinPay: share SAML metadata and a test account for SSO validation if possible (we can schedule a 30-min test).
- Redwood: we'll prepare a short packet (SOC 2 status, SSO metadata, RBAC matrix) once we hear back.

If it's helpful I can loop in our security lead (Rishi) to coordinate the evidence handoff — can you confirm the best contact?

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Attachment: vendor-questionnaire.xlsx (stub)

Thanks Samantha — appreciate the quick turnaround. Looping in Rishi (Head of Security) to own the evidence packet and coordinate any technical artifacts with Alex. Rishi — can you please confirm what we can share today versus what requires a secured share or NDA? Also we'll include: 
- Current SOC 2 status (we're in-scope with an external auditor; Type II expected Q3 2026; I believe we have an interim control summary we can share now).
- SSO metadata (SP metadata + recommended mappings).
- SCIM overview doc and supported attributes.
- RBAC matrix (CSV).

Proposed timeline:
- 05/12: Redwood sends initial evidence packet (interim SOC 2 summary, SSO metadata, SCIM overview, RBAC matrix).
- 05/14: FinPay returns completed questionnaire and, if possible, a test IdP account for SAML validation.
- Week of 05/18: schedule 30-min SSO test (Alex + Rishi/engineer).

If that works for you I'll mark those dates in HubSpot and share a secure Drive link for the artifacts.

Thanks,
Marissa

Hi Samantha / Alex —

Great to meet you virtually. Quick note on artifacts we can provide right away: 
1) Redwood SOC 2 status: interim control summary attached (redwood_soc2_status.pdf). Full Type II report is expected Q3 2026; we'll notify you as soon as the auditor publishes it.
2) SSO/SAML: attached SP metadata (redwood_sso_metadata.xml) and a short SSO integration checklist we use for IdP teams.
3) SCIM: scim-overview.pdf describes supported endpoints and attributes; we support group membership and user lifecycle via SCIM.
4) RBAC matrix: attached CSV (rbac-matrix.csv) showing built-in roles and typical permissions.
5) Audit logs: auth and admin event retention is 13 months by default; we can export relevant events for a time window if needed.

Links & next steps: 
- Shared package (secure Drive): https://drive.redwood.ai/finpay-security-package-20260510
- Proposed SSO test slots: 05/19 10:00-10:30 PT or 05/20 14:00-14:30 PT — Alex, which works for you?

If you prefer to receive certain items via your vendor portal or signed NDA, let us know and we'll adjust.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security | Redwood Inference
